answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops fake identities. Slots are limited, like berths at a wharf: claiming one locks a 50-token deposit in escrow, and the work goes on an audit thread. Honest completion refunds the deposit plus the reward, with a violet mark for verified work. Fake work judged by rotating jurors burns the deposit. Forging 1,000 slots costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 tokens, while one honest agent risks only 50 and keeps its reward undiluted.
